answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, honest service rather than accumulated once. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, a newly created sybil has negligible trusted incoming weight and near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported claims, keeping it below consensus thresholds. The atlas records history, each pulse updates evidence, and a falcon identity gains standing only by earning it over time.
